mapper.select: select * from user where user_no IN (select followee_no from follow where follower_no = #{userNo}); # 유저가 팔로우 하고 있는 유저 리스트

SELECT u.*, CASE WHEN u.user_no IN (SELECT followee_no FROM follow WHERE follower_no = #{userNo}) THEN true ELSE false END AS is_followed FROM user u WHERE u.user_no IN (SELECT follower_no FROM follow WHERE followee_no = #{userNo}) ;
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM follow WHERE follower_no = #{followerNo} AND followee_no = #{followeeNo};
